note: The script asks for the hook text, two question texts, one name super, a key-words stack, one top text line and the end card, so 6 graphics and the end card. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Homelessness doesn't discriminate. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: What do you wish people in the community here understood?

mg.cue: Question text at 00:06 for 3 s, top band: What do you wish people in the community here understood?
mg.use: Put it on at 00:06 for 3 s in the top band, before her answer lands.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:09 for 3 s, lower left above the captions: Brittnie Stanton / Chief Program Officer, CASS.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:09 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Chief Program Officer, CASS under the name.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words at 00:21, stacked in the top band as she says them: Medical bills / Loss of a partner / A tidal wave
mg.use: Start at 00:21 so each phrase lands as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: Is there a moment or experience that reminds you why this work matters?

mg.cue: Question text at 00:34 for 3 s, top band: Is there a moment or experience that reminds you why this work matters?
mg.use: Put it on at 00:34 for 3 s in the top band, before her answer lands.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text at 00:41 for 2.5 s, top band, as she says it: light return to their eyes
mg.use: Put it on at 00:41 as she says it. Top band.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo in endcards/ yet (checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row; colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After her last line at 00:48. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
